findings.label: No-ID Join submission
findings.finding: The newly visible no-ID form passes an empty session ID to the join action, producing /api/sessions//join.
findings.action: Recover the session ID from the invite code or provide an invite-code-only join endpoint if no-ID submission must succeed.

findings.label: Effective top-padding deviation
findings.finding: AppLayout adds pt-6 above the page container, so rendered content starts 24px below the specified zero top padding.
findings.action: Remove pt-6 if the literal padding contract must be enforced.

findings.label: Duplicated Campaign action styling
findings.finding: HomeView.vue and CampaignsView.vue duplicate the same scoped New Campaign button and label rules.
findings.action: Move the visual recipe into shared CSS or a reusable component to prevent drift.

findings.label: Missing browser regression coverage
findings.finding: No browser-level check asserts the exact sidebar, container, hero, route-background, or Join ordering contracts.
findings.action: Add focused Playwright coverage for the pixel-level and conditional-rendering requirements.
